# Noah Hova

Noah Hova is interested in mathematics, artificial intelligence, and personal projects. This is a public, human-readable summary for AI search tools; it is not a vector search or chat endpoint.

## Canonical profile

- AI-readable page: https://noahhova.com/ai.html
- Public code: https://github.com/nohov
- Contact: mailto:me@noahhova.com

## Public projects

- ScavScrap: an in-progress glasses-to-PC electronics guide. The glasses-to-laptop relay and an earlier recognition experiment are built; the guided lesson is planned. Source: https://github.com/nohov/Sightcuit/blob/main/README.md
- Deep-ML: hand-written machine learning and math practice solutions. Source: https://github.com/nohov/deep-ml/blob/main/README.md

For current project status, use the linked repository READMEs rather than inferring completion from this summary.
